segments.contextAfter: `completionHandler`: The completion handler to call when the load request is complete. This handler is executed on the delegate queue. If you pass `nil`, only the session delegate methods are called when the task completes, making this method equivalent to the [`downloadTask(with:)`](urlsession/downloadtask(with:)-1onj.md) method. This completion handler takes the following parameters: - **`location`**: The location of a temporary file where the server’s response is stored. You must move this file or open it for reading before your completion handler returns. Otherwise, the file is deleted, and the data is lost.
